title: Qayerdansiz?
hook_voice: Lesson seventeen. Where are you from? I'm from Uzbekistan.
hook_say: Chet ellik qayerdansiz deb so'rasa, nima deb javob berasiz?

example.en: Where are you from? I'm from Samarkand.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'n sakkizinchi dars: ranglar.
